verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a local CLI and C library that runs on Linux, Windows, macOS and iPhone, and its conversion commands operate on local files, so conversion clearly runs on the user's machine. However, the evidence contains no vendor statement that files are never uploaded. The product also documents optional network-facing features (a distributed pixel cache that offloads to remote servers, and URL coders that policy.xml can disable), which complicates any blanket no-upload claim. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that files are never uploaded, and documented offline/no-network guarantees or defaults.
